name: Funi-kun no Obenkyou
source:
Main character is the most unhappy student in the world as he never receives Valentine's chocolate.
This year he is desperate to get some. And he gets a bar of chocolate... from a furry kid Funi. The kid likes to study, but he has difficulty washing his head, so he asks protagonist to lend a hand. What will main character do now?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是世界上最不幸的学生，因为他从未收到过情人节巧克力。
今年，他渴望得到一些。结果他收到了一块巧克力……来自一个毛茸茸的孩子伏尼。这个孩子喜欢学习，却很难洗头，于是请求主人公帮忙。现在主人公会怎么做？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
